# Proverbs 16 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** To-man [are the]-arrangements-of [the]-heart, but-from-YHWH [is the]-answer-of [the]-tongue.

**2** All [the]-ways-of a-man [are] pure in-his-[own]-eyes, but-[the]-one-weighing spirits [is] YHWH.

**3** Commit to-YHWH your-works, and-your-plans will-be-established.

**4** Everything YHWH has-made for-its-purpose, and-even [the]-wicked for-[the]-day-of evil.

**5** [An]-abomination-of YHWH [is] every-[one]-proud-of heart; hand to-hand he-will-not-go-unpunished.

**6** By-lovingkindness and-truth iniquity is-atoned-for, and-by-fear-of YHWH [one]-turns-from evil.

**7** When-YHWH-is-pleased-with [the]-ways-of a-man, even his-enemies He-makes-to-be-at-peace with-him.

**8** Better [is] a-little with-righteousness, than-much produce without justice.

**9** [The]-heart-of a-man plans his-way, but-YHWH establishes his-step.

**10** An-oracle [is] upon-[the]-lips-of a-king; in-judgment his-mouth does-not-act-treacherously.

**11** A-balance and-scales-of justice [belong]-to-YHWH; all [the]-stones-of [the]-bag [are] His-work.

**12** [An]-abomination-of kings [is]-doing wickedness, for by-righteousness a-throne is-established.

**13** [The]-delight-of kings [are]-lips-of righteousness, and-one-speaking upright-things he-loves.

**14** Wrath-of a-king [is]-messengers-of death, but-a-man wise will-appease-it.

**15** In-[the]-light-of a-king's face [is] life, and-his-favor [is]-like-a-cloud-of spring-rain.

**16** To-acquire wisdom — how-much-better than-gold! And-to-acquire understanding [is]-to-be-chosen over-silver.

**17** [The]-highway-of [the]-upright [is] to-turn-from evil; one-guarding his-soul [is one]-keeping his-way.

**18** Before destruction [comes] pride, and-before stumbling [comes] haughtiness-of spirit.

**19** Better [is]-lowliness-of spirit with [the]-humble, than-dividing plunder with [the]-proud.

**20** One-attending to-a-word will-find good, and-one-trusting in-YHWH — blessed [is]-he.

**21** [The]-wise-of heart is-called discerning, and-sweetness-of lips increases learning.

**22** A-fountain-of life [is] understanding to-its-possessor, but-[the]-discipline-of fools [is] folly.

**23** [The]-heart-of [the]-wise makes-his-mouth-prudent, and-upon his-lips it-adds learning.

**24** A-honeycomb [are]-words-of pleasantness — sweet to-[the]-soul and-healing to-[the]-bone.

**25** There-is a-way [that is]-straight before a-man, but-its-end [are the]-ways-of death.

**26** [The]-soul-of [the]-laborer labors for-him, for his-mouth urges-him-on.

**27** A-man-of worthlessness digs-up evil, and-upon his-lips [it is]-like-a-fire scorching.

**28** A-man-of perversity sends-forth strife, and-a-whisperer separates a-close-friend.

**29** A-man-of violence entices his-neighbor, and-leads-him in-a-way not good.

**30** One-closing his-eyes to-devise perversities, one-compressing his-lips has-accomplished evil.

**31** A-crown-of beauty [is] gray-hair; in-[the]-way-of righteousness it-is-found.

**32** Better [is one]-slow-of anger than-a-mighty-warrior, and-one-ruling his-spirit than-one-capturing a-city.

**33** Into-the-lap is-cast the-lot, but-from-YHWH [is] all its-judgment.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **16:1**: Ma'arkhei lev — 'arrangements/plans of the heart.' The tension between human planning and divine sovereignty runs through this chapter.

- **16:18**: Lifnei shever ga'on — 'before destruction, pride.' The most quoted proverb on pride. Ga'on carries connotations of rising, swelling.

- **16:33**: Goral — 'lot.' Used for decision-making (cf. Jonah 1:7, Acts 1:26). The proverb asserts divine sovereignty over even random processes.

— EMET
